theme_strategy.aesthetic: Fintech Premium Educativa - Fusão entre a solidez do mercado financeiro e a agilidade da tecnologia moderníssima com elementos táteis de gamificação.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

mono_numeric.usage: Valores monetários, taxas (CDI, Selic, IPCA+), gráficos e simulações de rentabilidade

navigation.desktop_header: Glassmorphic backdrop sticky z-50 navy/white header with level badge, XP bar, theme toggle, profile avatar and tab buttons
navigation.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom bar with top 5 high frequency tabs + 'Mais' menu drawer for complete 10 tabs access

component_structure.header: Responsive Header bar with sticky top, theme switcher, XP gauge, tab selectors
component_structure.hero: Dynamic Hero with quick CTAs, live market metrics ticker (CDI 13.25%, Selic 13.25%, IPCA 4.15%), key badges
component_structure.learning_path: Visual 12-step interactive roadmap with node status (Concluído, Em andamento, Bloqueado) and XP rewards
component_structure.simulators_hub: Tabs for Juros Compostos, CDI vs Poupança, Selic, IPCA+, Renda Passiva, Comparador de Ativos with Recharts live graphics
component_structure.calculators_hub: Calculadora de Reserva de Emergência, Independência Financeira, Aportes Mensais, Rendimento Real pós-inflação
component_structure.strategies_hub: Perfil de Investidor (Conservador, Moderado, Arrojado) quiz + Alocação Recomendada de Ativos
component_structure.ai_assistant: Interactive financial AI chatbot with quick prompt pills (ex: 'Como começar com R$ 100?', 'O que é CDI?')
component_structure.progress_center: Gamification dashboard with Level status, XP bar, unlocked achievements, daily quiz for +50 XP
component_structure.glossary_view: Filterable A-Z terms dictionary with instant search, categorizations (Renda Fixa, Renda Variável, Cripto, Macroeconomia)
component_structure.content_articles: Rich educational articles grid with reading time, difficulty tag, and bookmark functionality
component_structure.user_profile: User profile with avatar, overall stats, certificates earned, history, Google/Email login modal
component_structure.footer: Rich footer with brand values, quick links, credit note to Eliel Souza (Instagram @eliel_souza_._)

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive button, tab, card, input, and metric MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page application experience with smooth tab navigation for all 10 key areas.
Implement real-time interactive financial simulators using Recharts and formulas in Portuguese.
Add gamification state (XP, current level, completed steps, unlocked badges) saved to localStorage or React state.
Include developer credits 'Eliel Souza (Instagram @eliel_souza_._)' prominently in the footer and user profile modal.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness with bottom navigation on mobile devices and responsive desktop headers.
Use high contrast colors, crisp typography, and generous spacing as per E1 principles.
